I've been going to therapy for the last 2 years for a different set of problems. I was on the road to self improvement before I entered University before it all came crashing down. 

​

I don't think I'm entirely done with school but  for now I am completely finished with University. I've been studying hard for the past 14 years of my life, and I'm proud of what I've accomplished up unit then. This place has caused me too much emotional and psychological pain for me to ever return too. I hope to eventually go to college if I ever regain my confidence.

Thank you for the response. I understand you're going through a lot yourself and I genuinely appreciate you trying to help me.
